title: Dragon Isle at Dusk
description: A massive dragon-shaped rocky island with green vegetation floats above a turquoise sea, its head and long tail forming the landmass. Two traditional wooden sailboats with red sails navigate the calm waters below under a dramatic sunset sky with glowing sunbeams breaking through purple clouds.
prompt: A majestic dragon-shaped rocky island covered in green moss and vegetation floats above a vibrant turquoise ocean, its head facing left and long scaled tail curving into the water. Two old wooden Chinese-style sailboats with bright red sails sail nearby. Dramatic sunset lighting with golden sunbeams piercing through heavy purple and pink clouds, reflections on the water, fantasy seascape, cinematic composition.
